research.title: Predictive Uncertainty Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare conformal prediction coverage under controlled shifts in tabular feature distributions.
Implemented weighted and unweighted calibration baselines, examining interval width and conditional coverage across predefined feature strata.

research.title: Regularization and Calibration with Noisy Training Labels
bullets: Planned experiments with supervisor guidance to examine how label corruption and regularization affect probabilistic classification on tabular datasets.
Compared logistic regression and neural classifiers using repeated data splits, calibration curves, and held-out log loss.

work.title: Data Validation and Batch Processing Reliability
bullets: Implemented validation checks for incoming records, handling missing fields and incompatible types before downstream batch processing.
Maintained automated tests for transformation logic and investigated processing failures through log review and reproducible input cases.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Sparse Regression Methods
bullets: Implemented ridge, lasso, and elastic net regression workflows with standardized features and cross-validation for penalty selection.
Compared prediction error and coefficient stability on synthetic datasets with correlated predictors and varying signal sparsity.

projects.title: Approximate Inference for Gaussian Mixture Models
bullets: Implemented expectation maximization and evaluated a variational inference baseline for Gaussian mixtures on synthetic and tabular datasets.
Compared held-out likelihood and clustering agreement while examining sensitivity to initialization, component count, and covariance assumptions.

projects.title: Bootstrap Uncertainty for Nonlinear Regression
bullets: Implemented residual and pairs bootstrap procedures to estimate prediction uncertainty for polynomial regression and regression trees.
Evaluated empirical coverage and interval width under heteroscedastic noise, distinguishing uncertainty in fitted means from future observations.
